create_InGraphEnv: create an InGraphEnv instance wrapping an OpenAI Gym environment into a TensorFlow graph
simulate_InGraphEnv: simulate a step in the wrapped Gym environment by passing a TensorFlow action tensor
reset_InGraphEnv: reset the wrapped Gym environment and return the initial observation as a TensorFlow tensor
access_InGraphEnv_observ: access the current observation variable from the InGraphEnv wrapped environment
access_InGraphEnv_reward_done: access the reward and done flag variables from the InGraphEnv wrapped environment
